proves: The shortest complete case: two tokens, two catalog rows, one phrase, and the class word read off the trailing token. Each token carries its own provenance rather than the identifier carrying one summary.
A three-token phrase ending in a class word. The trailing DT sets the identifier's class word; the two tokens before it set nothing.
Position is the whole class-word rule. DT designates a class word and says so on its own token, but it is not the trailing token, so the identifier reports no class word at all.
camelCase boundaries are found before any case folding, and raw keeps each token in the casing the identifier used.

Four camelCase words, none of them in this vocabulary. The class word is still reported from the trailing token, because the class-word map can answer what kind of value a column holds even when the catalog cannot say what the token means.

The acronym-run boundary goes before the last capital of the run, so this is ETL plus Timestamp and not ETLT plus imestamp. Both tokens are unknown here, which is what makes the split visible rather than hidden behind a lookup.

An acronym run, an allow-list-only token and a pinned collision in one identifier. TERM keeps its shape inside the phrase because an approved token is the governed form and re-casing it would be correcting the standard.
An ordinal is a token like any other. The catalog has nothing to say about 1, so it passes through and is_fully_known is false - the honest report, and the reason a pipeline can find the gap.

expected.phrase: TOTAL EXPOSURE One Million LIMIT Amount

proves: The two-pass digit join. The tokenizer splits 1MM at the letter/digit boundary exactly as it splits 7Code, and the second pass puts it back only because the catalog carries the joined form. Five tokens, not six.
A dotted nested path splits on dots and underscores alike, and the whole thing resolves case-insensitively from lower case.
A fully known identifier that ends in no class word. Knowing every token and being well formed are different properties, and only the second one is missing here.
Every token is known and none of them is approved. is_fully_known answers the expansion question only; the confidences below 1.0 are what say the catalog does not stand fully behind these rows.
